visual_name: One word in nine type styles, preloader
code_name: Camera pan over a tile wall
summary: A portfolio preloader that plays one word in many type treatments (lime on indigo with design icons, black ransom-note cutouts, a lime counter) then pulls back to show all nine as a 3 x 3 wall before landing on a plain big version.
